generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Accept user-authorized WeChat article links or copied content through the supported intake path; fetch and normalize permitted content, preserve provenance, deduplicate revisions, redact sensitive data, and dispatch qualified material to ingestion.

contract.purpose_user_function: Ingest WeChat article URLs embedded in authorized Apple Notes input, fetch and parse article HTML, normalize/redact content, deduplicate by note/content hash, preserve source metadata, and create wiki-ingest dispatch artifacts.
contract.valid_inputs: Apple Notes records or test fixtures containing a WeChat mp.weixin.qq.com URL, optional copied note body/source URL, apple-notes-ingest config, fetch timeout, dry-run/full/force-dispatch flags.
contract.expected_outputs: Normalized Markdown in the knowledge raw directory with WeChat provenance/frontmatter, manifest entries, JSON dispatch and wiki-ingest dispatch files, or explicit fetch/error/duplicate status.
contract.state_side_effects: On non-dry-run, fetches the article, writes raw Markdown, manifest and dispatch files, and updates last-scan/deduplication state. Scheduler install/uninstall can change a macOS LaunchAgent.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Missing body or fetch/parse failure records wechat_fetch_status/error; unchanged or duplicate content is not re-dispatched unless forced; dry-run avoids writes; redaction applies unless --full.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Implemented intake is the Apple Notes/macOS bridge, not a general WeChat account, Mini Program, clipboard, bot, login, or arbitrary channel connector. Authorization is implicit in user-provided note content, not a formal consent record.
contract.success_evidence: harness/lib/apple_notes_ingest.py: _select_wechat_url, _WechatArticleParser, _fetch_wechat_article, redact, content_hash and cmd_scan; tests/harness/test_apple_notes_ingest.sh.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: Valid article fixture; copied body with/without URL; fetch disabled/dry-run; timeout/network/parser/body failure; redaction versus full; new/changed/unchanged/duplicate content; provenance fields; dispatch creation/force; unsupported non-Apple-Notes intake.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md: /ingest command description; harness/config/apple-notes-ingest.json; docs/APPENDIX_B_CONFIG_FILES.md ingestion/config context.
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: harness/lib/apple_notes_ingest.py commands doctor, scan, status, install-scheduler and uninstall-scheduler; wiki-ingest dispatch file interface; /ingest AutoSci skill is downstream, not direct WeChat transport.
contract.config_schemas: harness/config/apple-notes-ingest.json: fetch_wechat, wechat_timeout_seconds, folder/tags/raw_dir; manifest version/content_index is implemented in apple_notes_ingest.py without a separate schema.
contract.implementation_entrypoints: harness/lib/apple_notes_ingest.py: cmd_scan/main and WeChat parsing/fetch helpers; harness/tools/apple_notes_ingest.py mirrored tool surface; write_wiki_ingest_dispatch.
contract.platform_provider_limitations: Live Apple Notes extraction and scheduler require macOS/AppleScript permissions; live WeChat fetch needs network access and page structure may change; fixture mode is deterministic.
